title: locator-spark-map-stepper-onboarding-visuals
creator: Ava Martinez
description:
Summary: Produce a set of onboarding and quickstart visual assets that explain Redwood's region/latency routing behavior via a compact map + interactive stepper flow. These assets will be used in the Console Quickstart, product docs, and the release announcement micro-site.

Goals:
- Communicate latency-aware routing decisions at glance for new users (developers & infra engineers).
- Provide screenshot templates and exports suitable for docs, blog, and in-console help.
- Ship both light and dark theme-ready map tiles and annotated overlays.

Deliverables:
- Figma frames: quickstart stepper (4 steps) + three responsive breakpoints (mobile/desktop/tablet).
- Map visual set: vector tile composition + latency contour overlays (50ms / 100ms / 200ms) + region highlight states (primary, secondary, fallback). Exports: SVG + optimized PNG @1x, @2x, @3x.
- Two annotated screenshot templates: Console Quickstart (map left, route policy editor right) and Docs hero banner (wide). PNGs for 1920x1080 and 1366x768.
- Microanimations: small pulse for selected region, slide-in stepper transitions (for product demo GIFs).
- Copy variants for stepper tooltip (concise, technical, and non-technical).
- Asset inventory doc in Drive with export instructions and naming conventions.

Design constraints & specs:
- Map style: simplified basemap (low-contrast land + muted water). Use Redwood brand accent palette for region highlights: --redwood-accent-1 (#0066FF), --redwood-accent-2 (#00A2FF), fallback pattern uses 45° hatch with 40% opacity.
- Latency contours: use three translucent bands (green: <=50ms, amber: 51-100ms, red: >100ms) with 20% opacity. Contours should be labeled with small badges (text size 11px).
- Interactions for demo assets: hover states show tooltip with region name, median p50/p95 latencies, and number of nodes.
- File size: optimize PNG exports to be <=1.5MB where possible for web; SVGs must be icon-optimized and include outlines for fonts.
- Accessibility: ensure 4.5:1 contrast for stepper text over background and include alt text for every exported asset.

Acceptance criteria:
- All frames and exported assets uploaded to the Drive folder and Figma prototype link.
- Two screenshot templates (1920x1080 and 1366x768) exported in both themes and added to docs assets repo.
- Designer walkthrough with PM + ENG to verify that latency bands reflect provided telemetry (ENG-6142).
- Copy variants approved by PM and localized strings prepared for i18n team if needed.
- PRD plus final asset manifest linked in the ticket and a follow-up bug ticket created for any small visual fixes.

Notes & trade-offs:
- We will use simplified geographic detail to keep focus on routing decisions; no city-level labels except major hubs.
- Animated GIFs will be exported at 10fps to balance filesize vs clarity.
- If ENG cannot provide real p95 telemetry in time (ENG-6142), use synthetic latency buckets and mark asset as "synthetic-data" until telemetry is available.

- Drive asset folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB2cDesignAssets_Routing
- PRD: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/PROD/Region+Routing+V2+PRD
